items.name: Product hero
items.description: Introduce a product with a clear promise and a working preview.
items.detail: A product introduction with primary and secondary actions, plus a live project card built from Rayden components. The centred variant presents a focused text-only hero.
items.try: Try both calls to action and complete a project step. Compare the centred, loading and error states.

items.name: Feature overview
items.description: Turn a set of capabilities into a useful, scannable story.
items.detail: A feature section with real follow-up actions, two visual treatments and explicit recovery states. Each action reveals the local explanation for its capability.
items.try: Explore a feature, compare plain and card layouts, or restore the demo from its empty state.

items.name: Site footer
items.description: A considered last stop, with grouped links and locale preferences.
items.detail: A complete footer for a fictional studio, with grouped native links and a controlled language preference. Destinations lead to a local demo region; choosing a language updates the preference without translating the page.
items.try: Choose a footer link and change the demo language to Français. The result appears below the footer.

items.name: Site header
items.description: Navigation, announcements and workspace controls in a shared header.
items.detail: A responsive header with callback-driven destinations, a project action, and alternative search and workspace variants. Each control reports a local outcome.
items.try: Choose Projects, create a demo project, and try the search and workspace variants. On mobile, open the navigation menu.

items.name: Page header
items.description: Give a project its context, status and next actions.
items.detail: A project header combines breadcrumbs, metadata, status and an action overflow. The approval action updates local state; unavailable deletion explains why it cannot be used.
items.try: Approve the demo, follow a breadcrumb, and open More actions. Compare the plain and error states.

items.name: Product detail
items.description: A closer look at a product, with gallery, options and quantity.
items.detail: A fictional notebook detail view demonstrates gallery selection, cover options, quantity and local add-to-bag feedback. It uses prices in minor currency units and never creates an actual purchase.
items.try: Choose a cover, change the quantity and add the notebook to the demo bag. Try the stacked, sold-out and pending states.

items.name: Checkout review
items.description: Let people review the details before a final confirmation.
items.detail: A fictional order review with delivery, payment summary, line items and totals. Edit controls cycle local demo choices; confirming only shows a demonstration result and does not place an order.
items.try: Edit the delivery option, payment summary or cart quantity, then confirm the demo. Compare pending and error states.

items.name: Recent transactions
items.description: A readable activity ledger with selectable transaction details.
items.detail: A compact list of fictional incoming and outgoing records. Selecting a row reports its details, while See all expands the local collection. No banking service is connected.
items.try: Select a transaction, view all activity, then return to the recent list.

items.name: Create account
items.description: A complete registration form, with password guidance and clear feedback.
items.detail: A registration interface with local validation, password confirmation, consent and explicit submission states. The preview never sends personal details or creates an account.
items.try: Use example details, enter matching passwords, tick the demo consent, and submit. Compare loading, submitting and error states.

items.name: Task list
items.description: A working team checklist with owners, dates and completion.
items.detail: A controlled task list with local completion, creation, deletion and assignment. Search and filters help find the next task. The fixed reference date keeps the demo repeatable.
items.try: Complete a task, add a new one, filter the list or change an assignee. Compare empty and read-only states.

items.name: KPI overview
items.description: A clear view of progress, with context behind every number.
items.detail: A reporting summary with explicit periods, comparisons and metric selection. Every value is illustrative; switching periods swaps the local demonstration dataset.
items.try: Switch the reporting period and select a metric. Try the loading, error and empty states.

items.name: Workspace switcher
items.description: Move between workspaces without losing your sense of place.
items.detail: An interactive workspace selector with search and an unavailable entry that explains the access restriction. Switching only updates the local demonstration.
items.try: Open the switcher, filter for Personal and choose it. Compare the unavailable, loading and empty experiences.

items.name: Command palette
items.description: One place to find a page, a preference or your next action.
items.detail: A searchable command menu with grouped actions, keyboard navigation and an explicitly unavailable billing entry. Each available command reports a local demo outcome.
items.try: Open the palette, search for project, and choose an action. Try arrow keys, Enter and Escape.

items.name: Product collection
items.description: An image-led collection with working product and quick-add actions.
items.detail: A fictional stationery collection rendered as a grid or list. Selecting a product shows its details; quick-add increments a local demo bag count without creating an order.
items.try: Select a notebook or add it to the demo bag. Compare grid and list views, then try empty and error states.

items.name: Notifications
items.description: Useful updates, contextual actions, and a way to catch up.
items.detail: A notification feed with unread state, review actions and a handoff link. Every action stays inside the preview and reports its outcome.
items.try: Review the prototype, view the handoff, or mark all notifications as read. Reset restores the unread feed.

items.name: Empty state
items.description: Give an empty workspace a useful, welcoming next step.
items.detail: A composed empty state with a library illustration, explanatory copy and a working action. Creating the first demo project replaces the empty state with a confirmation.
items.try: Create your first project, then return to the empty state. Compare the inline and monochrome appearances.

items.name: Application shell
items.description: A workspace frame with responsive navigation and room for your product.
items.detail: Compose a sidebar, top bar, and main workspace without tying the interface to a particular router. This example switches local navigation state and adds to a demo project count.
items.try: Switch between Overview and Projects, then add a demo project. Use the mobile viewport to try the navigation menu.

items.name: Profile settings
items.description: Personal details, editable fields, and a considered save flow.
items.detail: Start a profile editor with labelled fields, draft tracking, cancellation, and feedback. Changes here are saved only to local React state and disappear when the preview resets.
items.try: Edit the first name, save it, then try the error and loading states. Cancel restores the current demo profile.

items.name: Searchable table
items.description: Search, sort, and select records in a single working surface.
items.detail: A data-table composition with local text filtering, sortable columns, and controlled row selection. Use it as a starting point for project lists and other records; your application owns real data and persistence.
items.try: Search for “Brand”, sort by Project, and select a row. Switch to the empty state to see a collection without records.

items.name: Sign in
items.description: A focused sign-in form with clear input and feedback states.
items.detail: An authentication interface that exposes submission and recovery callbacks to your application. The showcase does not authenticate users or send credentials; use example values only.
items.try: Enter a demo email and password and submit the form. Try the password visibility toggle, error state, and pending state.

items.name: Pricing plans
items.description: Compare plans, switch billing periods, and choose a next step.
items.detail: A pricing comparison with controlled billing periods and explicit selection callbacks. Prices belong to a fictional product used for demonstration. Rayden UI itself is free and MIT-licensed.
items.try: Switch from monthly to yearly billing and choose a plan. The confirmation is local to this preview and creates no subscription.

items.name: Shopping cart
items.description: Editable quantities, item removal, and a readable order summary.
items.detail: A cart interface using prices in minor currency units and controlled line items. This example recalculates demo totals when quantities change; checkout does not create an order or take payment.
items.try: Change a quantity, remove an item, and try the empty cart. Continue shopping restores the demo products; the empty cart offers Explore the collection.

items.name: Avatar
items.description: Give people a recognisable place in an interface.
items.detail: Initials and icon avatars demonstrate availability indicators and a grouped collaborator list with overflow. The example owns the local availability and expansion controls.
items.try: Show all collaborators, set Avery away, and compare the icon appearance.

items.name: Badge
items.description: Small labels that communicate a meaningful state.
items.detail: Semantic status badges compare draft, review and approval labels across accent, outline and filled appearances. A demo action cycles the current project status.
items.try: Move the demo project through its statuses and compare the badge appearances.

items.name: Banner
items.description: A shared announcement with a clear next step and dismissal.
items.detail: A banner presents a fictional update with an action and a functioning dismissal control. Restoring the announcement makes the interaction repeatable.
items.try: Explore the update, dismiss it and show it again. Compare bold and warning appearances.

items.name: Breadcrumb
items.description: Show where someone is and offer a path back.
items.detail: A short breadcrumb trail represents local workspace, project and detail views. Following a parent updates the demo trail and content; the final item remains the current location.
items.try: Choose Projects or Workspace, then reopen the Northline project. Compare slash separators and borders.

items.name: Button group
items.description: Related choices, held together in one compact control.
items.detail: A group of three buttons controls a local schedule view. The selected button exposes its pressed state and the content summary reflects that choice.
items.try: Switch between Day, Week and Month. Compare the disabled state.

items.name: Card
items.description: Compose a project summary from a header, content and actions.
items.detail: Card primitives combine a project header, status badge, progress indicator and working footer actions. The example keeps project progress and saved state local.
items.try: Complete the checklist, save the demo project, and compare outlined, elevated and ghost surfaces.

items.name: Chip
items.description: Keep selected tags visible and easy to remove.
items.detail: A controlled set of input chips represents project tags. Removing a chip updates the selected count; Restore tags returns the initial set.
items.try: Remove a tag and restore the set. In the disabled state, removal is unavailable.

items.name: Counter
items.description: A bounded quantity control with an immediate result.
items.detail: A controlled counter selects one to five notebooks and updates an illustrative total. Minimum and maximum limits prevent invalid values.
items.try: Increase the quantity to its limit and decrease it again. Compare pill and disabled appearances.

items.name: File upload
items.description: Select documents locally, with type, size and count validation.
items.detail: A controlled file-selection interface accepts up to three TXT or Markdown files of one megabyte each. It displays metadata only and performs no upload; the populated state uses illustrative file metadata.
items.try: Select a small text file, remove it, or try an unsupported file to see validation feedback. Compare populated and disabled states.

items.name: Pagination
items.description: Break a collection into manageable, predictable pages.
items.detail: A controlled paginator moves through nine demo projects in groups of three. Page buttons update both the visible records and the result summary.
items.try: Move to the next page, select page three, and return to the first page.

items.name: Progress circle
items.description: A compact view of progress toward a definite finish.
items.detail: A circular indicator reflects a four-step demo setup. Completing a step updates the accessible value and the visible percentage; Restart returns progress to zero.
items.try: Complete the remaining steps, restart, and compare the segmented appearance.

items.name: Stepper
items.description: Guide a short flow with visible progress and room to go back.
items.detail: A controlled stepper presents a three-stage project setup. Continue and Back update the active stage; finishing shows a local demonstration result and a restart action. Small screens automatically use the vertical orientation.
items.try: Move through all three stages, go back, finish and restart. Compare horizontal and vertical layouts.

items.name: Accordion
items.description: Keep helpful detail within reach, one question at a time.
items.detail: Accordion primitives organise related questions into expandable sections. This example compares a single open section, multiple open sections and a nested appearance.
items.try: Open the theme question, then compare the multiple and nested states. Use the keyboard to activate each heading.

items.name: Checkbox
items.description: Independent preferences with a clear select-all state.
items.detail: Controlled checkboxes demonstrate independent choices and an indeterminate select-all control. The selected count reflects the actual local preference state.
items.try: Choose individual update types or toggle Select all updates. Compare the disabled state.

items.name: Radio
items.description: A single, deliberate choice from a small set of options.
items.detail: A labelled radio group controls one delivery preference at a time. Native grouped inputs support keyboard navigation; this demo sends no messages.
items.try: Choose Daily digest or Only the essentials. Use the arrow keys within the group.

items.name: Toggle
items.description: Small switches for preferences that take effect immediately.
items.detail: Two controlled toggles demonstrate independent workspace preferences. The summary updates as the controls change, without changing settings outside the preview.
items.try: Turn focus mode off and interface sounds on, then compare the disabled controls.

items.name: Slider
items.description: Adjust a value with both a broad gesture and precise steps.
items.detail: A controlled slider adjusts an illustrative intensity value from zero to one hundred in steps of five. The visible summary follows its actual value.
items.try: Drag the thumb or focus it and use the arrow keys. Compare its disabled appearance.

items.name: Progress bar
items.description: Make progress visible and give completion a clear end point.
items.detail: A controlled progress indicator advances through five demo checklist steps. Its percentage and supporting text stay in sync, and the action disables on completion.
items.try: Complete the remaining steps, start again, and compare the segmented appearance.

items.name: Tooltip
items.description: A little context, exactly where someone needs it.
items.detail: A tooltip attached to a real button appears on hover or keyboard focus. Its supporting text explains a demo action; activating the button reports a local save.
items.try: Hover or focus Save draft, then activate it. Compare the initially open state.

items.name: Alert
items.description: Clear information, useful actions and an easy dismissal.
items.detail: A banner alert demonstrates information, success, warning and error tones. The review action reports local feedback, and a dismissed message can be restored.
items.try: Review the draft, dismiss the message, and show it again. Compare all four tones.

items.name: Button
items.description: Clear primary actions and quieter secondary choices.
items.detail: Buttons communicate the next action through supported variants and states. This example uses primary, secondary, grey, and text variants with real local click handlers.
items.try: Trigger an action and watch the local count. In the disabled state, the first two buttons are unavailable.

items.name: Input
items.description: Labelled text fields with helpful and error feedback.
items.detail: A controlled text input and an email field demonstrate labels, supporting text, disabled state, and errors. Native input attributes remain available for your application’s form behaviour.
items.try: Change the full name and watch the profile text update. Switch to the error state to inspect the email feedback.

items.name: Select
items.description: A focused choice from a labelled set of options.
items.detail: A controlled Select with SelectOption children keeps the chosen role in React state. Use the keyboard or pointer to open the list and choose a supported value.
items.try: Choose Developer or Product manager. The selected role updates below the field.

items.name: Date picker
items.description: An interactive calendar for choosing a single date.
items.detail: A controlled DatePicker starts on a fixed demo date and reports the selected day. The package also documents range and year modes; this example focuses on a single-date interaction.
items.try: Choose another day, move between months, or clear the selection. The text below reports the selected date.

items.name: Tabs
items.description: Switch between related views with a shared visual rhythm.
items.detail: Controlled Tabs and Tab children organise related workspace sections. The consuming example owns the content region and updates it when the selected value changes.
items.try: Switch to Activity or Settings, then compare the segmented and line appearances.

items.name: Dropdown menu
items.description: Keep contextual project actions close at hand.
items.detail: Compose a trigger, content, label, and menu items for contextual actions. The actions in this example update a local message; no project is changed outside the preview.
items.try: Open Project actions, choose Duplicate project, then reopen it and try keyboard navigation or Escape.

items.name: Modal
items.description: A deliberate pause before an important action.
items.detail: A controlled confirmation dialog combines a title, explanatory copy, and primary and secondary actions. This example lets you cancel or archive a fictional project without affecting real data.
items.try: Open the confirmation, use Keep project or Escape, then try Archive demo. Reset starts the example again.

items.name: Table
items.description: Readable records with a sortable project column.
items.detail: Table, header, row, and cell primitives provide the structure while your application owns the data and sorting. The Project header toggles the order of a small local collection.
items.try: Activate the Project column heading twice to reverse the order. Use the empty state to inspect the custom empty row.
